title: Embedding: Test harness (P/F/O/B/ST/SEC suites)
description:
Implement embedding test harness from docs/plans/01-ai-core.add01-test-harness.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: Full test harness doc

Key deliverables:
- Property tests P1-P5: batch splitting ordering, dimension bounds, cost monotonicity, registry isolation, task type mapping completeness
- Fault injection F1-F4: provider API errors (429/400/500/timeout), partial batch failure, malformed response handling, context cancellation
- Oracle O3: Embed() entry point contract (O1/O2 deferred to provider plans)
- Benchmarks B1-B4: registry lookup <100ns, batch split overhead <1ms, vector validation <1us, cost calc <100ns
- Stress tests ST1-ST3: concurrent registry access (100 goroutines), large batch 100k texts, concurrent Embed calls (50×1000)
- Security SEC1-SEC2: input validation (empty/null/oversized/bad dims), API key handling
- CI tier mapping: Tier 1 (P+F+O3+SEC), Tier 2 (B+ST)
- Exit criteria: 100+ property iterations, no panics, benchmarks meet targets, -race clean, 90%+ coverage

Depends on: Embedding core implementation task.
